# Wild Pokémon: Pokémon Sapphire NDS

Every area with wild Pokémon, as the game has them. The tables are Sapphire's own (from the pokeruby decompilation), with the same odds per slot.
Levels above 24 are raised to go with the Exp. Share (levels up to 24 are unchanged), so the levels here are the ones you meet.

- Each rod fishes its own table, as in Gen 3: the Old Rod, the Good Rod and the Super Rod.
- Rock Smash: breaking a rock sometimes starts a battle, as in Gen 3.
- Percentages add up the slots of the same Pokémon.
